ambient_events: A door clicks somewhere down the gallery, then silence folds back over the floor.
The lilies on the console table are, impossibly, always fresh.
description: A hushed residential floor: a curved gallery of numbered doors set into panelled walnut, a runner of deep carpet swallowing every footstep, and a window at the end framing the bay far below. Fresh lilies stand on a console table. Three private residences open off this landing — north, east, and west. Step in to the elevator.
name: The Residences
